versions.changelog:
Initial release of the Honduran Content Engine skill:

- Autonomous tool for short-form video production focused on Honduran food trends.
- Produces audience-facing content in Spanish with an English management UI.
- Extracts daily trending topics, scripts 50-second videos, and generates SEO-optimized metadata packages.
- Outputs include topics, scripts, media recommendations, and metadata, all presented in an English-language operator interface.
